description: Update an existing note by id. Provide at least one of `title`, `body`, or `folder`; omitted fields are left unchanged. Set `folder` to 'unfiled' to move the note to the root. Returns the updated note.

body.description: New body text (replaces the current body)

folder.description: Move to this directory id; 'unfiled' for the root; omit to leave as-is

name: update_note
title: Update note
